title: Pub/Sub Adds Client Telemetry for Publish Operations
summary: New `PubsubClientTelemetry` and `PublishOperation` schemas provide client-side debugging information for publish calls, including hedging attempts and start times.
details: Developers can now gain deeper insights into their Pub/Sub client's publish behavior. The new `PubsubClientTelemetry` schema, intended to be sent via the `x-goog-pubsub-client-telemetry` header, includes a `publishOperation` field. This `PublishOperation` object exposes `hedgedAttemptCount` to track publish hedging attempts and `publishStartTime` to indicate when a publish call was initiated. This offers better end-to-end latency visibility and enhanced debugging capabilities for client-side issues.
